description: This Java class 'DittoStatusAndHealthProviderFactory' provides a factory method to create instances of 'StatusAndHealthProvider' for the Ditto cluster. It includes configurations for health checking and utilizes various helper classes and suppliers to determine cluster status and health.

classes.name: DittoStatusAndHealthProviderFactory
classes.description: A final class that serves as a factory for creating 'StatusAndHealthProvider' instances tailored for the Ditto cluster, encapsulating the setup of status and health suppliers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'StatusAndHealthProvider' configured with the given ActorSystem, cluster state supplier, and health check configuration.
